name: Crossed Paths:Connected Worlds
source:
A visual novel about a high school senior named Claire who's life keeps throwing things at her and feels she's at her breaking point, when she finds a mysterious necklace in the woods. That night she meets Sophronia, a girl her age with the exact same necklace who tells Claire that their necklaces have the ability to travel to other worlds!

[Edited from [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=40492]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 30[/url].
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，讲述高中毕业生克莱尔的故事。生活不断向她施加压力，让她感觉自己快要崩溃时，她在森林中发现了一条神秘项链。当天晚上，她遇见了与自己同龄的索芙罗妮娅，对方也戴着一模一样的项链，并告诉克莱尔，她们的项链能够穿越到其他世界！

[改编自[url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview&uid=40492]Ludum Dare[/url]]

为[url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-30/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 30[/url]创作。
